official_measurement_examples.name: Essential rural worker need
official_measurement_examples.fact: Current NPPF allows isolated countryside housing where there is an essential need for a rural worker, including a person taking majority control of a farm business, to live permanently at or near the place of work.

official_measurement_examples.name: Need assessment factors
official_measurement_examples.fact: Planning guidance says relevant evidence includes operational necessity, enterprise viability, succession need, alternatives in existing accommodation and whether a temporary trial dwelling is appropriate for a new enterprise.

official_measurement_examples.name: Seasonal-worker limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Planning guidance says employment on packing or assembly lines, or a general need to house seasonal workers, will not usually by itself justify an isolated rural dwelling.

official_measurement_examples.name: Occupancy condition distinction
official_measurement_examples.fact: A rural-worker occupancy condition controls who may occupy a planning permission; it does not establish freehold ownership, a tenancy right or the profitability of the enterprise.

official_measurement_examples.name: Removal of condition evidence
official_measurement_examples.fact: Local policies commonly require evidence that the functional need has ceased and that restricted-market demand has been properly tested before an occupancy condition is removed; the exact test remains authority and policy specific.

official_measurement_examples.name: Tenancy-law separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Assured agricultural occupancy rights arise under housing law from employment and tenancy circumstances and are separate from a planning occupancy condition attached to land-use permission.

official_measurement_examples.name: Dwelling size and enterprise
official_measurement_examples.fact: Local rural-worker policies can require the dwelling size and cost to be commensurate with the functional need and viability of the enterprise; an essential need does not imply unrestricted dwelling scale.

official_measurement_examples.name: Parcel limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: A rural-worker policy case does not establish title, unrestricted residential use, exact buildable area or final development yield without site-specific permission and condition evidence.

core_rules: rural occupation alone is not essential-need evidence
essential need requires enterprise and functional evidence
seasonal worker need is not automatically isolated-dwelling need
enterprise viability and functional need remain distinct tests
temporary trial dwelling is not permanent permission
occupancy condition is not freehold ownership
occupancy condition is not tenancy law
assured agricultural occupancy is not planning permission
condition removal requires authority-specific current policy evidence
marketing evidence does not itself remove a condition
dwelling scale must remain commensurate with justified need
condition does not calculate land value
condition does not calculate development yield
no parcel rural-worker clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
